R7.1 the task line is shown without Markdown emphasis markers
R7.2 requirements and the contracts inside each one are ordered by criterion number
R7.3 a contract that was not required is labelled "not required for this task" when it passes and "not built yet" when it fails

R4.1 each pinned file is fetched at the commit, hashed, and marked matching or different
R4.2 a receipt with no commit gets a message that the file check needs a commit
R4.3 a file in uncommitted is marked not in the commit yet, not different

R8.3 every animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
R8.4 a failing contract row is drawn as a gravestone and a passing one as alive, with CSS only

R2.1 every contract is listed by name with pass or fail, with spec, commit and receipt hash
R2.2 contracts named R<n>.<m> are grouped by requirement
R1.2 a raw GitHub receipt link in the query is accepted and any other link is refused
R5.1 a copyable command clones the repository at the commit and runs necro verify on the receipt
